dossier_meta.statement_text: Determine the correct threshold $q^*(n)$ such that almost every $q$-colouring of the hypercube $Q_n$ is reconstructible from the multiset of its coloured 1-balls, narrowing the gap between the lower bound $q = \Omega(n)$ and the upper bound $q \geq n^{2+\varepsilon}$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 1.2 shows that for $q \geq n^{2+\varepsilon}$ almost every $q$-colouring of $Q_n$ is 1-distinguishable, while a counting argument shows that $\Omega(n)$ colours are necessary for reconstruction from 1-balls. The authors note explicitly that 'it would be interesting to narrow the gap', with further discussion deferred to Section 6 (open questions).
